ui.tagline: Cut your videos: put clips, pictures, sound and titles on a timeline with several tracks, trim and split them, fade them in and out — and export a finished film.
ui.dropPreview: Drop here: onto the timeline at the playhead
ui.title: Title
ui.tlEmpty: Drag videos, sound or pictures from the media panel (or from your folder) onto a track.
ui.binEmpty: No media yet. Import videos, sound and pictures — or drop them on the window.
ui.binHint: Drag a file onto a track, or double-click it to put it at the playhead.
ui.noSelection: Select a clip on the timeline to change it.
ui.multiHint: Change one clip at a time; several can be moved to the clipboard, duplicated or deleted together.
p.textHint: Text of the title (Enter: new line)
pp.name: Name
pp.hint: Frame size and frame rate are those of the exported film; clips of another size are fitted in with black bars.
exp.title: Export film
exp.missingFile: {name} is missing — find it in the media panel first.
exp.offline: {n} files of this project are missing. Find them in the media panel (“Find file…”) before exporting.
exp.noFfmpeg: Exporting needs the FFmpeg that comes with the installed app. This copy of Video Studio was started without it (a development build). Install Video Studio from Studio Hub or the releases page.
set.title: Settings
set.languageHint: The language of menus and dialogs.
set.autoHide: Hide bars automatically (they slide in at the screen edge)
set.restore: Open the last project again at start (also unsaved changes)
set.snap: Clips and playhead snap to cuts (hold Alt while dragging to switch it off)
set.imageSec: Length of a picture on the timeline
toast.emptyTimeline: The timeline is empty — there is nothing to export yet.
toast.exportRunning: An export is running — stop it first.
toast.missing: {n} files of this project are missing — they are marked red.
toast.notProject: {name} is not a Video Studio project.
toast.nothing: Video Studio can't use these files.
toast.nothingToSplit: There is no clip under the playhead.
confirm.discard: The project has unsaved changes. Discard them?
confirm.quit: The project has unsaved changes. Close anyway? (They stay in Video Studio and come back at the next start.)
keys.drag: Move a clip / trim at its edge
keys.wheel: Zoom the timeline at the mouse
keys.hint: Click a shortcut and press the new keys. Backspace removes it, Esc cancels.
keys.needMod: Please with Ctrl or Alt (or a function key).
keys.taken: {k} belonged to “{a}” — that has no shortcut now.
keys.fixed: {k} belongs to “{a}” and can't be changed.
about.p1: Video Studio cuts videos from your computer: clips, pictures, sound and titles on several tracks, exported as a finished film. Nothing is uploaded; it needs no account.
about.p2: Part of the Studio family — theme, layout and language are shared with the other Studio apps.
about.licenses: Exporting uses FFmpeg (LGPL 2.1, built without GPL parts, shipped as its own program next to Video Studio; its license and source are in the program folder).
pv.unplayable: The preview can't play this file (it is still exported)
